children: U.K. 30-year government bond yields, or gilt yields jump to their highest level since 1998, but this could offer investors attractive carry opportunity, Natixis strategists say in a note. "Curve steepness in the long end reflects structural drivers like quantitative tightening, heavy long-end supply and regulatory change, as much as macro fundamentals, creating carry opportunities at current yield levels," they say. The U.K. budget statement due on October 28, could be a key inflection point as the fiscal watchdog, the Office for Budget Responsibility, is due to deliver an assessment on fiscal credibility, the strategists say. U.K. 30-year gilt yields climb 10 basis points to 5.886%, having earlier hit 5.893%, their highest since 1998, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
